title: Jim Taylor Day of Service
summary: Watch Jim Taylor Day of Service and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog
body_markdown:
Brixmor teams across the country came together for our annual Jim Taylor Day of Service, honoring the legacy of our former CEO, Jim Taylor, and his belief that strong companies have a responsibility to strengthen and give back to the communities they serve.


Food drives at our shopping centers were a major focus of this year's efforts. Through the generosity of our teams, partners, and local communities, these initiatives generated more than 36,000 pounds of food for families in need, helping make a meaningful difference in neighborhoods across the country.


Beyond the food drives, teams partnered with local organizations to give back in ways unique to their communities. In Orlando, team members decorated and filled duffle bags for Foster Love to support children entering foster care. Our Dallas office volunteered at A ReStore by Habitat for Humanity, Detroit partnered with the Troy Nature Society to remove invasive buckthorn and preserve local habitats, and our New York City office delivered meals through Citymeals on Wheels to support homebound older adults. These efforts are just a few examples of the many volunteer projects completed across the country.


Thank you to our teams, community partners, vendors, and nonprofit organizations for helping make this year's service day such a success.


Jim's legacy lives on through the culture of service he inspired, and we're proud to continue that tradition in the communities where we live, work, and serve.
